{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mos Eisley Achives''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It contained a copy of the [[Colonial Survey Files]] that [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] accessed to complete his report on the events surrounding the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].
